verdict.rationale: Fastmail's features page documents snoozing messages so they return to the Inbox later, and its offline-support doc confirms that snoozed messages reappear at the scheduled time. Nothing in the pack shows a follow-up reminder that resurfaces a thread only if nobody replies, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: reply-conditional follow-up reminders, a detailed snooze how-to (conversation-level scope, time options), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
